title: GhostNet-AI frame result
description: What the AI returns for ONE sonar frame. Generated from ghostnet/contract.py by ai/scripts/export_schemas.py; do not edit by hand. Contract version 1.0.0.

detection_id.description: Stable per-detection identifier, unique within a frame.

class.description: Detected class, from the closed vocabulary.

raw_score.description: Uncalibrated detector score. Diagnostic only; do NOT display or threshold on it.

calibrated_confidence.description: Temperature-scaled probability. This is the number to show and threshold on.

uncertainty.description: Confidence band for the UI. Capped at medium while the model is uncalibrated, so a low band is a real claim.

bbox.description: [x, y, width, height] in pixels, top-left origin.

mask.description: Optional polygon, [[x, y], ...]. Null when the model is detection-only.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude. Null when geometry or the nav fix was unavailable; never fabricated.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude. Null under the same conditions as latitude.

position_error_m.description: Radius of the position-uncertainty circle, metres. Render this, not a bare pin.

localization.description: How the position was derived. A value of none means no position is claimed.

review_status.description: Human review state. Owned by Member 2 after ingest; the AI always emits pending.

model_version.description: Version of the model that produced this detection.

width.description: Across-track size in ground metres, after slant-range correction. Null if unavailable.

length.description: Along-track size in metres. Null unless the along-track pixel scale is known.

status.description: Estimated from sonar geometry; measured only with verified range resolution and altitude; otherwise unavailable.

artificial_verification.description: Why this was judged artificial or natural.

shadow_context.description: Acoustic-shadow support, the classic side-scan cue for a raised object.

survey_id.description: Identifier of the survey this frame belongs to.

frame_id.description: Identifier of the frame within the survey.

detections.description: Reported detections. An empty list is a valid, meaningful result: clean seabed.

provenance.description: Model, dataset, preprocessing and calibration versions behind this result.

warnings.description: Non-fatal conditions. Surface these in the UI; they explain missing positions and suppressed detections.

contract_version.description: Semver of this contract. A major bump is a breaking change for Member 2.
